description:
Non-Material
Amendment to planning permission reference 202850 granted 11/02/21 for the
provision of the following: Rewording of pre-commencement conditions 5(Construction
Logistics Plan), 6(Highway Condition Survey), 7(Sustainable Urban Drainage), 8(Technical
Approval of Highway Structures), 11(Site Contamination)  and 16 (Written Scheme of Investigation)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Condition
7 of planning permission reference 202850 is amended to read as follows:<o:p></o:p></span></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior
to the commencement of development on site, except for limited below ground
works up to a maximum depth of 1 metre as identified within the dashed red line
of submitted plan LBS-OTB-00-00-DR-S-0009 Rev. P03 a SUDS (Sustainable Urban
Drainage System) to deal with all surface water drainage from the site,
including details of proposed rainwater harvesting systems, green roofs and
proposed soakaway designs together with infiltration test results and
recommended soakage rates, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local
Planning Authority. The approved SUDS shall be fully implemented prior to first
occupation of any building and thereafter maintained in accordance with the
agreed details for the lifetime of the development. &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:
To prevent the increased risk of flooding, both on- and off-site ensure that
adequate drainage facilities are provided in accordance with Policies CS4 and
CS15 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan - Core Strategy (2012) and Policy
DM34 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan – Development Management Policies
(2013).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Condition
5 of planning permission reference 202850 is amended to read as follows:</span></u><br></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">No
development shall take place on site except for limited below ground works up
to a maximum depth of 1 metre as identified within the dashed red line of
submitted plan LBS-OTB-00-00-DR-S-0009 Rev. P03 until a detailed Construction
Logistics Plan has been submitted to and approved by the local planning
authority. The logistics plan shall include details of site access, journey
planning, access routes, hours of delivery, temporary traffic arrangements or
restrictions, site operation times, loading and unloading locations and
material storage. All works shall be carried out in accordance with the
approved details throughout all demolition and construction works.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:
To ensure considerate construction and to protect the amenities of the nearby
residents to ensure that disruption is kept to a minimum and does not affect
highway traffic flows to comply with Policies CS7 and CS13 of the adopted
Waltham Forest Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM14 DM15, DM24 and DM32 of
the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan – Development Management Policies (2013).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Condition
6 of planning permission reference 202850 is amended to read as follows:</span></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior
to the commencement of development, except for limited below ground works up to
a maximum depth of 1 metre as identified within the dashed red line of
submitted plan LBS-OTB-00-00-DR-S-0009 Rev. P03 a highway condition survey of
the carriageway and footways within the red line boundary of the application
site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority. This is required prior to the substantive commencement of any works
and must be submitted to the Council’s Highways team for records and must
include a site plan showing the location of the photographs. The condition
survey is required in addition to the highway works, to ensure, if the public
highway is damaged as a result of the construction works this will be
reinstated by the Council and funded by the developer.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:
To ensure considerate construction and to protect the amenities of the nearby
residents to ensure that disruption is kept to a minimum and does not affect
highway traffic flows to comply with Policies CS7 and CS13 of the adopted
Waltham Forest Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM14 DM15, DM24 and DM32 of
the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan – Development Management Policies (2013).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Condition
8 of planning permission reference 202850 is amended to read as follows:<o:p></o:p></span></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">No
development shall take place on site, other than site clearance, investigation
works and the limited below ground works up to a maximum depth of 1 metre as
identified within the dashed red line of submitted plan LBS-OTB-00-00-DR-S-0009
Rev. P03, until Technical Approval of the structure and in particular how the
development affects the existing highway structures, including any
modifications to these (in the form of Approval in Principle submission in
accordance with Highways Standard CG 300) is submitted to, and approved in
writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The Technical Approval shall be
constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to the occupation of
the development and retained for the lifetime of the development. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:
In the interest of highway and pedestrian safety, in order to comply with
Policies CS7 and CS15 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan – WFLP Core
Strategy (2012) and Policies DM14, DM15 and DM29 of the adopted Waltham Forest
Local Plan – Development Management Policies (2013).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Condition
11 of planning permission reference 202850 is amended to read as follows:<o:p></o:p></span></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Prior
to commencement of construction works, except for limited below ground works up
to a maximum depth of 1 metre as identified within the dashed red line of
submitted plan LBS-OTB-00-00-DR-S-0009 Rev. P03 a scheme including the
following components (where applicable) to address the risk associated with
site contamination shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority (LPA). <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">A.
A Desk Study report including a preliminary risk assessment and conceptual site
model. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">B.
A ground investigation based on the findings of the Desk Study Report to
provide information for a detailed assessment of the risk to all receptors that
may be affected, including those off site. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">C.
The results of the investigation and revised risk assessment and based on
these, in the event that remediation measures are identified necessary a
remediation strategy shall be submitted giving full details of the remediation
measures required and how they will be undertaken. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">D.
A verification report providing details of the data that will be collected in
order to demonstrate that the works set out in the remediation strategy are
complete<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Any
investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken in accordance with the
Environment Agency’s Model Procedures for the Management of Contaminated Land
(CLR11). In the event that additional significant contamination is found at any
time when carryout the approved development it must be reported immediately to
the LPA.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>













</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:
To ensure the risks from land contamination to future users of the land and
neighbouring land are minimised, together with those to controlled waters,
property and ecological systems, and to ensure that the development can be
carried out safely without unacceptable risks to workers, neighbours and other
offsite receptors in accordance with Policy CS13 of the adopted Waltham Forest
Local Plan – Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM24 and DM34 of the adopted
Waltham Forest Local Plan – Development Management Policies (2013). For the
avoidance of doubt, this condition can be discharged on a section by section
basis.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Condition
16 of planning permission reference 202850 is amended to read as follows:<o:p></o:p></span></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">No
demolition or development except for limited below ground works up to a maximum
depth of 1 metre as identified within the dashed red line of submitted plan
LBS-OTB-00-00-DR-S-0009 Rev. P03 shall take place until a written scheme of
investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved by the local planning
authority in writing. &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">For
land that is included within the WSI, no demolition or development beyond those
specified above shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed WSI,
which shall include the statement of significance and research objectives, and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><br>
A. The programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the
nomination of a&nbsp; competent person(s) or
organisation to undertake the agreed works<br>
B. Where appropriate, details of a programme for delivering related positive
public benefits<br>
C. The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis,
publication &amp; dissemination and deposition of resulting material. this part
of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been
fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the WSI.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>







</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:
To safeguard the archaeological interest on this site. Approval of the WSI
before works begin on site provides clarity on what investigations are
required, and their timing in relation to the development programme, in compliance
with Policies DM28, of the Waltham Forest Local Plan – Development Management
Policies (2013) and NPPF Section 16 (2019) and the Draft London Plan 2017
Policy HC1.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>
